resources.string: Region-level front-camera gaze tracking, 5-point calibration + 4-point held-out validation, pitch-compensated brow-raise & command-blink triggers, and section attention analytics.

Raw front-camera frames are analyzed strictly in volatile device RAM to extract Eye-ROI pupil centroids, eyebrow displacement, and 3D head Euler angles—camera images are never saved or transmitted. Derived calibration matrices and session summaries persist locally on-device by default and sync to your private Cloud Firestore vault only when Cloud Sync is explicitly enabled.
OPTED IN: Calibrations & session summaries sync to your private Firestore vault.
OPTED OUT (Default): Zero cloud telemetry — all data stays strictly on-device.
This permanently deletes all calibration profiles and attention session telemetry stored under /users/%1$s in Cloud Firestore. Your on-device local calibration profile will remain intact.
Speech output unavailable: install or enable a text-to-speech engine in system settings. Tile phrases are shown but not spoken.
Fixate on each of the 5 screen coordinates (Center, Top-Left, Top-Right, Bottom-Left, Bottom-Right) as the target ring pulses to collect binocular iris & 3D head-pose gaze data points.
